title: 第3章 怒打纨绔
content_zh:
就在赵硕被众人的目光盯的坐立不安的时候，夫子轻咳一声，神情怪异的看了赵硕一眼道：“好了，大家静一静，我想赵硕方才是和大家开了一个玩笑，我们继续”

吐出一口浊气，赵硕感激的看了夫子一眼，老老实实的坐在那里，抱着多听少说的念头，尽可能的多了解一些这个世界，免得再犯一些常识性的错误，不然的话，只怕真的要被当成傻子看待了。

可惜的是赵硕想要从夫子这里得到更多的关于这个世界的常识有些不太可能了，因为随着夫子许多总结性的话语说出，赵硕才知道过了今天自己就该离开学馆，正式成年了。

迷迷糊糊的走出学堂的时候，一股清新的空气扑面而来让迷茫的赵硕清醒了许多，正准备打起精神回家的时候，忽然一股大力从背后传来，紧接着赵硕就感到自己整个人向前栽倒了过去。

噗通一声，随着一股剧痛传来，赵硕趴在地上，膝盖处传来火辣辣的痛意，转过身来，当看清楚站在一旁的人是谁的时候，心中不由得升起一股怒意。

陈天贵一脸得意的看着赵硕嘿嘿笑道：“赵草包，真想不到啊，你还真是深藏不露啊，怎么一天不见就又傻了那么多啊……”

一旁和陈天贵站在一起的几个人闻言似乎想到了不久前赵硕的一番话不禁跟着哈哈大笑起来。

深吸一口气，赵硕握紧拳头，微微低着头，眼中闪过一道寒光，不过很快慢慢的将握紧的拳头松开。

缓缓的站起身来，忍着膝盖上传来的痛意，略带踉跄的向前走，对于陈天贵的挑衅根本不予回应。

赵鸾见到赵硕的情形，眼中闪过一道痛惜的神色，快步跑到赵硕的身边，一边搀扶着赵硕一边恶狠狠的盯着正色*的打量着她的陈天贵道：“陈天贵，你竟然又欺负二哥！”

虽然发怒，可是清丽动人的赵鸾却显得愈发的靓丽，直看的陈天贵狂咽口水。

陈天贵恨不得将赵鸾给吞到肚子里去，向前几步欺到赵鸾和赵硕的身前，一脸陶醉的吸了一口空气道：“嗯，真是好香啊！”

赵鸾脸上泛起泛起一丝晕红，眼中满是羞怒的神色，下意识的后退了一步。

前生身为孤儿，从没感受到多少亲情，可是短短一个早上的时间，却让赵硕从赵鸾以及楚秀那里感受到了什么叫做亲情，什么事家的感觉。

此刻见到陈天贵竟然如此的戏弄赵鸾，赵硕忍着痛意向前一步挡在赵鸾的身前，猛的握紧了拳头冲着陈天贵那张可恶的大脸狠狠的砸了上去，口中怒吼道：“欺负我可以，但是不许欺负我妹妹！”

根本就没有一点防备的陈天贵哪里会想到一向懦弱的赵硕竟然会突然爆发给自己这么一下，顿时只觉得脸上火辣辣，鲜血、眼泪不由自主的流下来，脸上像是开了花似地。

赵硕见到陈天贵那副凄惨的模样不禁一阵快意，他娘的，老子可不是以前的那个懦夫了，竟然敢调戏老子的妹子，不打你个满脸桃花开我就不是赵硕。

站在陈天贵身边的几人被突如其来的变化给惊呆了，甚至有人不敢相信的揉了揉眼睛，当确信陈天贵的确被赵硕一拳给砸的满脸鲜血不由自主的退后一步。

见鬼，一向软弱的赵硕竟然会给陈天贵来这么一下，真是不可思议啊。

反应过来之后，陈天贵伸手在脸上抹了一把，鼻子像是碎了一般，眼泪哗哗的流下来，虽然是酸痛难忍，但是当看到赵硕的时候，陈天贵不禁怒由心生，仿佛是受了天大的屈辱一般，冲着赵硕吼道：“好你个赵硕，你竟然敢打我，你真是找死”

见到陈天贵那副狰狞的模样，赵鸾吓了一跳，连忙拉着赵硕道：“二哥，咱们快跑！”

可惜的是赵硕与赵鸾两人根本就只是普通的少年罢了，根本就没有办法同陈天贵这等进行过星图开启灵窍的人相比。

虽然陈天贵废物了一些，但是修行之人的力量确实不是常人可以抵抗的。

当拳头落在身上的时候，赵硕只觉得一股股的痛意传来，任由赵硕反抗，但是他的力气比起陈天贵来当真是差了太多，只能护住要害倒在地上任由陈天贵踢打发泄。

赵鸾先是吓了一跳紧接着像是发怒了的狮子一般冲着陈天贵扑上去，可惜的是她那点力气甚至连赵硕都比不上，哪里能帮到什么忙，若非陈天贵打她的主意的话，只怕没几下就要被打的不能动弹了。

全身的骨头仿佛断了一般，赵硕咬紧牙关愣是不发出一声来。

此时正是下学的时间，赵硕与陈天贵等人搞出的动静立刻就吸引了不少人围观。

几名身着华丽衣衫的少年男女看到陈天贵踢打赵硕的时候不禁皱了皱眉头，不过见到赵硕竟然如此的坚毅，眼中露出诧异的神色，毕竟赵硕生性懦弱他们还是有所耳闻的。

但是现在看陈天贵满脸鲜血的模样，如果不是陈天贵口中的怒吼声的话，他们还真的不敢相信陈天贵脸上的鲜血会是一向懦弱的赵硕给打的。

“够了，陈天贵，出口气也就算了，这里是学馆，同时别忘了，你是一名修行之人，如此欺负一个普通人，你不要脸面，我们还丢不起这个人呢！”

一名锦衣少年淡淡的道，声音虽然不大，可是听在陈天贵的耳中却是如同惊雷一般。

一脸艳羡和敬畏的看了那少年一眼，陈天贵狠狠地在赵硕的身上踹了一脚道：“赵硕，今天算你命大，看在赵礼公子的面子上，暂且饶你一命。”

赵鸾扑到赵硕的身边将凄惨无比的赵硕搀扶起来，力气太小的缘故，一个踉跄，两人差点一起倒在地上。

透过满脸的鲜血，赵硕先是冷冷的看了一眼陈天贵，目光又在那几名身着锦衣华服的少年男女身上扫过，强自支撑着身体在一众人各异的目光中离开。

出了学馆，赵鸾看到赵硕满脸鲜血的模样不禁道：“二哥，都怪我，你要是出了什么事情的话……”

赵硕颤声道：“傻丫头，你是我妹妹，我是你亲哥哥，难道要二哥要眼看着你被人欺负不成”

赵鸾闻言，眼睛一酸，眼泪不由自主的流了下来，赵硕见了强自露出一丝笑意道：“都是大姑娘了，再哭的话可就不好看了”

伸手将脸上的泪水抹去，赵鸾道：“二哥，我带你去看大夫！”

当两人从医馆出来的时候，赵硕的模样已经好了许多，让两人松了一口气的是好在赵硕护住了要害部位，只是受了一些皮肉伤而已，修养一些时日就会没事了。

回到家中的时候，楚秀看到一双儿女那副模样差点昏过去，连忙将赵硕扶到房间之中，一脸疼惜的看着赵硕道：“这是怎么了，早上出去的时候还是好好的，怎么会弄成这幅模样？”
content_en:
Just when Zhao Shuo was fidgeting under everyone's gaze, the Master coughed slightly, looked at Zhao Shuo with a strange look and said, "Okay, everyone, be quiet. I think Zhao Shuo just made a joke with everyone, let's continue."

Exhaling a breath, Zhao Shuo glanced at his master gratefully, and sat there honestly, with the idea of listening more and talking less, trying to learn as much as possible about the world, so as not to make common sense mistakes again, otherwise, he would really be treated as a fool.

It is a pity that it is impossible for Zhao Shuo to get more common sense about the world from the Master, because after the Master said many concluding words, Zhao Shuo realized that after today, he should leave the school and officially become an adult.

When he walked out of the school in a daze, a breath of fresh air hit his face, which made the confused Zhao Shuo sober up. Just when he was about to cheer up and go home, suddenly a strong force came from behind, and then Zhao Shuo felt himself falling forward.

There was a pop, followed by a sharp pain. Zhao Shuo lay on the ground, burning pain was felt in his knees. He turned around, and when he saw clearly who was standing beside him, he couldn't help but feel anger rising in his heart.

Chen Tiangui looked at Zhao Shuo with a proud look and said with a smile: "Zhao idiot, I can't believe that you are so secretive. Why did you become so stupid after just one day of not seeing each other..."

Several people standing with Chen Tiangui heard this and seemed to think of what Zhao Shuo said not long ago and couldn't help laughing.

Taking a deep breath, Zhao Shuo clenched his fists and lowered his head slightly. A cold light flashed in his eyes, but he soon slowly loosened his clenched fists.

He stood up slowly, endured the pain in his knees, staggered forward slightly, and did not respond to Chen Tiangui's provocation at all.

When Zhao Luan saw Zhao Shuo's situation, a look of regret flashed in his eyes, and he quickly ran to Zhao Shuo's side. While supporting Zhao Shuo, he stared at Chen Tiangui who was looking at her seriously and said: "Chen Tiangui, you bullied my second brother again!"

Although he was angry, the beautiful Zhao Luan looked even more beautiful, and Chen Tiangui swallowed his saliva as he looked at her.

Chen Tiangui wished he could swallow Zhao Luan into his stomach. He took a few steps forward and approached Zhao Luan and Zhao Shuo. He took a breath of air with an intoxicated look on his face and said, "Well, it smells so good!"

A trace of blush appeared on Zhao Luan's face, his eyes were full of shame and anger, and he subconsciously took a step back.

As an orphan in his previous life, he never felt much family affection, but in just one morning, Zhao Shuo felt from Zhao Luan and Chu Xiu what family affection is and what family feels like.

Seeing Chen Tiangui teasing Zhao Luan like this at this moment, Zhao Shuo endured the pain and took a step forward to block Zhao Luan. He clenched his fist and punched Chen Tiangui's hateful face, roaring: "You can bully me, but you are not allowed to bully my sister!"

Chen Tiangui, who was completely unprepared, would never have thought that Zhao Shuo, who had always been cowardly, would suddenly explode and attack him like this. He suddenly felt that his face was burning, blood and tears flowed down involuntarily, and his face seemed to be blooming.

Zhao Shuo couldn't help feeling happy when he saw Chen Tiangui's miserable look. Damn it, I'm not the coward I used to be. You dare to tease my sister. If I don't beat you up, I won't be Zhao Shuo.

Several people standing next to Chen Tiangui were stunned by the sudden change. Some even rubbed their eyes in disbelief. When they were convinced that Chen Tiangui had indeed been punched by Zhao Shuo and his face was full of blood, they involuntarily took a step back.

Hell, it's incredible that Zhao Shuo, who has always been weak, would do this to Chen Tiangui.

After reacting, Chen Tiangui stretched out his hand and wiped it on his face. His nose seemed to be broken, and tears flowed down. Although the pain was unbearable, when he saw Zhao Shuo, Chen Tiangui couldn't help but feel angry, as if he had suffered great humiliation. He shouted at Zhao Shuo: "You Zhao Shuo, you dare to hit me, you are really looking for death."

Seeing Chen Tiangui's ferocious look, Zhao Luan was startled and quickly pulled Zhao Shuo and said, "Second brother, let's run!"

It is a pity that Zhao Shuo and Zhao Luan are just ordinary teenagers. There is no way to compare with people like Chen Tiangui who have performed star maps to open spiritual orifices.

Although Chen Tiangui was a little wasteful, the power of a cultivator is indeed not something that ordinary people can resist.

When the fist fell on his body, Zhao Shuo only felt waves of pain coming from him. He allowed Zhao Shuo to resist, but his strength was much inferior to that of Chen Tiangui. He could only protect his vitals and fell to the ground, letting Chen Tiangui kick him to vent his anger.

Zhao Luan was startled at first, and then rushed towards Chen Tiangui like an angry lion. Unfortunately, her strength was not even comparable to that of Zhao Shuo, so she could not help. If Chen Tiangui had not had her idea, she would have been beaten to the point where she could not move in a few blows.

All the bones in his body seemed to be broken. Zhao Shuo gritted his teeth and did not make a sound.

It was time for school to end, and the noise made by Zhao Shuo, Chen Tiangui and others immediately attracted many people to watch.

Several young men and women in gorgeous clothes couldn't help but frowned when they saw Chen Tiangui kicking and beating Zhao Shuo. However, they had surprised looks in their eyes when they saw Zhao Shuo being so determined. After all, they had heard that Zhao Shuo was weak by nature.

But now looking at Chen Tiangui's face covered with blood, if it weren't for the roar in Chen Tiangui's mouth, they really couldn't believe that the blood on Chen Tiangui's face was caused by the always cowardly Zhao Shuo.

"That's enough, Chen Tiangui, forget about being angry. This is a school. At the same time, don't forget that you are a practitioner. You bully an ordinary person like this. You are shameless. We can't afford to humiliate this person!"

A young man in brocade clothes said calmly. Although his voice was not loud, it was like thunder in Chen Tiangui's ears.

Looking at the young man with envy and awe, Chen Tiangui kicked Zhao Shuo hard and said, "Zhao Shuo, you are lucky today. For the sake of Mr. Zhao Li, I will spare your life for the time being."

Zhao Luan rushed to Zhao Shuo and helped the miserable Zhao Shuo up. Because his strength was too weak, he staggered and the two of them almost fell to the ground together.

Through the blood on his face, Zhao Shuo first glanced at Chen Tiangui coldly, and then swept his eyes over the young men and women in brocade clothes. He forced himself to support his body and left under the different eyes of everyone.

After leaving the academy, Zhao Luan saw Zhao Shuo's face covered with blood and couldn't help but said: "Second brother, it's all my fault. If something happens to you..."

Zhao Shuo said in a trembling voice: "Silly girl, you are my sister and I am your brother. Do you want the second brother to watch you being bullied?"

Hearing this, Zhao Luan's eyes were sore and tears flowed down involuntarily. Zhao Shuo saw Qiang Zi and showed a smile: "We are all big girls now. It won't look good if we cry again."

Reaching out to wipe away the tears on his face, Zhao Luan said: "Second brother, I will take you to see the doctor!"

When the two came out of the hospital, Zhao Shuo's appearance had improved a lot. The two were relieved that Zhao Shuo had protected his vital parts and only suffered some flesh injuries. He would be fine after some time of recovery.

When she returned home, Chu Xiu almost fainted when she saw the appearance of a pair of children. She quickly helped Zhao Shuo into the room, looked at Zhao Shuo with a look of pity and said, "What's going on? You were fine when you went out in the morning. How could it be like this?"
